jobs.description: Do you have a passion for technology and enjoy turning individual components into fully functioning machines? Are you hands-on, technically skilled and comfortable working with mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems? Then this could be your next opportunity! For a modern technical production environment in Horst, we are looking for an Assembly Technician who takes pride in precision, quality and craftsmanship. You will work in a day-shift position alongside experienced colleagues, assembling advanced machinery in a professional and dynamic environment. What’s your job about? As an Assembly Technician, you will be responsible for assembling high-quality machinery and components. Your tasks will include: Building and assembling machines, equipment and technical installations. Interpreting technical drawings, diagrams and assembly instructions. Installing mechanical, electrical and hydraulic components. Fitting and connecting parts to machine frames and units. Inspecting finished assemblies to ensure quality and accuracy. Maintaining a clean, organized and safe working environment. What skills do you have? At least 2 years of relevant experience in technical assembly or industrial production. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings. Practical knowledge of mechanical, electrical and/or hydraulic systems. Strong technical insight and a hands-on mentality. Physically fit and comfortable handling tools and machine components. Flexible and capable of working in different positions and working conditions. Good communication skills in English. Note: Accommodation and transportation are not provided for this position. What do you get in return? Full-time employment (40 hours per week). Fixed day-shift working schedule. Competitive salary based on your experience and technical skills. Work with advanced machinery and modern technology. Opportunities to expand your technical knowledge and expertise. You will join a leading international company specializing inagricultural machinery and innovative technological solutions. The organization designs and manufactures advanced equipment for professional agricultural applications, combining engineering expertise with modern production techniques. Quality, innovation, safety and sustainability are at the heart of its operations. You will become part of a skilled and dedicated team where technical knowledge, collaboration and craftsmanship are highly valued.
